newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen opening steady to higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen opening steady to higher in quiet trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to start steady to higher on Friday, with trade likely to be very light after the Thanksgiving holiday.

Analysts said traders might shift from blue-chip stocks to small-capitalization or technology shares after drops in the Dow Jones Industrial Average in the last two sessions. The Dow closed at 6499 on Wednesday, down 29 points.
Government data on personal income and consumption out at 0830 EST/1330 GMT is not seen as affecting the market.
